A complete workspace on Mac

Mac 1.1.0 is now on the App Store. The native SwiftUI and AppKit workspace puts session history, live transcripts and AI help side by side. Runs on macOS 14 or later, on Apple Silicon and Intel.

  • Capture microphone, system audio or both; optionally save M4A or WAV recordings.
  • Search with Command-F, edit transcript lines and export Markdown with Command-Shift-E.
  • Control listening from the menu bar or Option-Shift-D; replay, export or delete recordings without losing the text.

Free dictation, clear data paths

Free dictation needs no API key. Apple speech recognition may process audio on the device or send it to Apple when local recognition is unavailable. Cloud transcription and AI send data directly to the provider you select and authorize. We do not run a backend receiving your recordings or transcripts.

Apple speech recognition

Recording controls

On iPhone, leaving the app or locking the phone stops dictation. On Mac, use the window, menu bar or Option-Shift-D to start and stop capture; quitting stops capture. Obtain any required participant consent before recording or transcribing.

How a session goes

Listen, ask, then keep the record on the device. Cloud and AI uses share one trial counter.

Listen
Allow the microphone. On-device dictation needs no key. Add a speech provider you trust only if you want cloud transcription.
Ask
Request a reply, a summary, a critique, an explanation, or a short forecast. Those requests go to the AI provider you configured.
Keep
History and recordings stay on the device unless you export or share them. We have nowhere to receive them.

Price, plainly

The app is free to install. The unlock is a non-consumable one-time purchase. Family Sharing is on. Restore with the same Apple ID on iPhone and Mac.

Stays free
Free Apple Speech dictation on Mac and iPhone, session history and local recordings. Cloud transcription and AI are optional.
One-time unlock
Cloud transcription, optional live translation, and AI replies: 20 trial uses, then a one-time purchase, about US$9.99. Apple sets the local price. This is not an auto-renewing subscription.
No hosted quota from us
The app ships with no developer API keys and does not proxy requests. Whoever you pick sends the bill. You can also point it at your own compatible chat completions endpoint.

Common questions

Do I need an API key to start?

No. After you allow the microphone and speech recognition, on-device dictation works. Keys are only needed for cloud transcription and AI replies.

Is this a subscription?

No. On-device dictation stays free. Cloud transcription, optional live translation, and AI replies share 20 trial uses, then a one-time App Store unlock. Family Sharing is available.

Where do audio and text go?

Free dictation needs no API key. Apple speech recognition may process audio on the device or send it to Apple when local recognition is unavailable. Cloud transcription and AI send data directly to the provider you select and authorize. We do not run a backend receiving your recordings or transcripts.

Which systems and languages?

Mac 1.1.0 requires macOS 14+. iPhone 1.0.1 requires iOS 17+. Both offer 13 interface languages.

Do Mac and iPhone automatically sync history?

No. Session history, recordings and API settings remain on each device. Restoring the same App Store unlock on Mac and iPhone does not synchronize those files. Export or share the files you need yourself.

Is free dictation always offline?

No. Apple Speech prefers on-device recognition on Mac, but may send audio to Apple if an offline model is unavailable or fails. iPhone may also use Apple speech services. Offline availability depends on the language, model and system.

Record, transcribe, or summarize only where it is legal and you have any required consent. Suggested replies can be wrong and are not professional advice.
